notes.title: Journey so far..
notes.content:
Artifice: War Tactics - Major Updates Overview 
  
Hello, Strategists!
    
With the official release of Artifice: War Tactics just around the corner, it's time to look back at the major updates we've rolled out during our Early Access period. Each update has been crucial in enhancing the gameplay experience, and we owe it all to your invaluable feedback and support.

        Major Update 1: New Character and Bug Fixes    
Highlights:
            New Champion: Added a new champion, each with unique abilities that enhance strategic depth.        Bug Fixes: Resolved several critical bugs, improving game stability and performance.        UI Improvements: Enhanced interface for better navigation and user experience.        
In our first significant update, we introduced a new champion to the roster, bringing fresh abilities and strategies to the battlefield. We focused on addressing key bugs and improving overall game stability, ensuring a smoother experience for our players.

    Major Update 2: Gameplay Changes and Balance Updates    
Highlights:
            Balance Adjustments: Reworked champion abilities and enemy AI for more dynamic battles.        New Items: Introduced a variety of new items to expand tactical options.        Improved Mechanics: Refined core mechanics to enhance tactical depth and player engagement.        
The second update brought substantial gameplay changes and balance adjustments to enhance strategic depth. We refined champion abilities and reworked several game mechanics to provide a more challenging and rewarding tactical experience.

    Major Update 3: New Champion and Closed Beta    
Highlights:
            New Champion: Added a new champion with distinct skills, further diversifying team strategies.        Closed Beta Launch: Initiated a closed beta for players to test upcoming features and provide feedback.        Quality of Life Improvements: Made several interface and usability enhancements based on player feedback.        
This update unveiled another new champion, adding more diversity to your tactical options. We also launched a closed beta phase, allowing select players to test upcoming features and provide feedback, helping us shape the future of the game.

    Major Update 4: Controller Support and New Biome    
Highlights:
            Full Controller Support: Implemented full controller support for an enhanced gaming experience.        New Biome: Introduced a new biome with unique challenges and environments.        Visual Upgrades: Improved graphics and animations for more immersive gameplay.        
With the fourth major update, we introduced full controller support, making the game more accessible to a wider audience. We also added a new biome, complete with unique challenges and environments, expanding the game's world.

    Major Update 5: Ability Upgrades and New Champion    
Highlights:
            Ability Upgrades: Enabled players to upgrade champion abilities, adding depth to strategy.        New Champion: Introduced a new champion with specialized tactics and abilities.        New Quests and Items: Added additional quests and items to further enrich gameplay.        
Our fifth update focused on enhancing the depth of gameplay with ability upgrades, allowing players to further customize and strengthen their champions. Additionally, we introduced a new champion, bringing fresh tactics and strategies to explore.

    Major Update 6: Launch with New Battles and Gameplay Enhancements    
Highlights:
            New Battles and Bosses: Launched new challenging battles and formidable bosses to conquer.        Gameplay Enhancements: Implemented player-suggested improvements for a refined experience.        Expanded Champion Roster: Added new champions with unique abilities for diverse tactics.        
The final update marks the official launch of Artifice: War Tactics, featuring new battles, bosses, and champions. We've implemented numerous gameplay enhancements based on player feedback, ensuring an unforgettable tactical experience.
    
We are thrilled to share this journey with all of you and can't wait for you to experience everything Artifice: War Tactics has to offer. Your support and feedback have been instrumental in shaping the game, and we are incredibly grateful.
    
See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Major Update 2 - Major Gameplay Changes, Balance Updates & more!
notes.content:
We are equally thrilled and nervous to announce this next big update for Artifice: War tactics. From all the feedback we have received we have concluded that the game as it stands is not fun enough and lacks emergent gameplay due to the probabilistic nature of its combat system. As such the game will now feature an active combat system that will allow players to attack during their turn rather than setting an overwatch. Such a massive change was a tough pill to swallow at first but after a lot of playtesting we feel confident that overall, this system feels way more intuitive, exciting, emergent, and frankly more fun. We hope you enjoy this update and as always please feel free to reach out to us with your feedback. Tons more updates coming soon so stay tuned.

Please note that your current save files will be deleted as it will be incompatible with the new updates. We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

Artifice: War tactics Demo will now be available with the updated gameplay changes. 

HIGHLIGHTS

 Core gameplay update – Active attack: All champions can now actively attack any enemy that falls within their attack range (previously overwatch zone)

 New rule – All champions must perform at least one action: Move or Attack. All Champions can move and attack in any order.
 Asymmetrical combat system - Enemies set up overwatch zones that can be avoided in numerous ways:

 A Champion can avoid movement by attacking any enemy that falls within their attack range from their current position.
 Champions can now actively eliminate or disrupt the overwatch of enemies that pose a threat to an ally. Champion traits and abilities can now be used with more accuracy allowing for more devastating combos. Tutorial has been reworked as per the new combat rules.
 The order of islands in the campaign has been rearranged with the starting island being Mycella: Realm of Boletuza.
 HUD has been overhauled segmenting Character stats on the left and attack and ability buttons on the center.

BALANCE

 All Champions base armor reduced from 1 to 0.
 Maximum number of enemies on the battlefield increased from 5 to 6.
 Enemy spawns and reinforcement count reworked for provinces in each island.
 Updated Champion XP requirement for each level based on current balance updates.
 Double move ability has been removed from Emissary.
 Sand worm damage increased from 1 to 2.
 Items - An overhaul of nerfs across most items due to the change in the core gameplay. Jagged edge – Reduce Crit chance from 20 to 10.
 Ritual Dagger – Removed -1 Armor negative stat.
 Serrated Edge – Reduced Bleed chance from 25 to 15 and Crit chance penalty from -25 to -5.
 Firebrand – Reduced Burn chance from 25 to 15. Removed -1 Damage penalty and replaced with -10 Resistance chance penalty.
 Siphoning Dagger – Reduced Lifesteal from 3HP to 2HP. Removed -25 Crit chance penalty.
 Boletari Dagger – Reduced Poison chance from 25 to 15. Removed -20 Resistance chance penalty.

notes.content:

notes.title: Launch Patch Log
notes.content:
Artifice: War Tactics now includes the following:

 2 Islands: Aziera and Mycella.
 5 Battle Modes: Vanquish, Ambush, Escort, Retrieve and Rescue.
 6 Champions: Zephyr, Pyromancer, Ranger, Berserker, Pathfinder, and Blood Fury.
 8 Enemy Types: Sellsword, Bowmen, Terrodon, Siege Breaker, Shaman, Death Cap, Shroom Knight, and Shroomancer.
 2 Bosses: Xo’Azora and Queen Mycella.
 61 Items: Attack, Defense, and Utility.
 3 Biomes: Snow, Desert, and Boss Arena.
 Biome Hazards: Sandworm (Desert) and Snow (Frost Wraith).
 Champion Trait and Ability upgrades.


Balance Changes:

 Concussive blast upgrade reworked with a new status effect “Winded” that disables the target’s overwatch for 1 turn.
 Frost Wraith now repositions at the start of player turn.
 Sandworm and Frost Wraith now attack after every overwatch trigger rather than at the end of all of them. 
 Double move (Ember Bomb) is now a self-casting ability.
 Updated Biome hazards spawn Logic. Hazards no longer spawn in the same grid twice.
 Reworked Multiple Champion Abilities: 
 Zephyr: Swapped Eagle Eye with Pathfinder’s Dual-Watch ability.
 Ranger: True Strike replaced with Armor Chink.
 Pyromancer: Cauterize replaced with Cleansing Flames and Fire Bomb replaced with Napalm.
 Berserker: Rampage replaced with Cleave.
 Pathfinder: Swapped Dual-Watch with Zephyr’s Eagle Eye ability.
 Blood Fury: Splinter Bomb replaced with Sacrificial Edict and Assassinate.
 Added turn timer trigger in Retrieve mode. Turn timer begins only after retrieving the artifact.
 Sandworm now inflicts bleed, but damage is reduced by 1.
 Reworked Frost Bite (now does Armor Negation).
 Updated the XP reward logic.
 Removed Burn, Poison, and Bleed resistance stats and replaced with a unified Resistance stat.
 Reworked stats for all enemies and champions.


Polish and Tweaks:

 Added a highlight on the hover for any interactive objects or NPCs – such as Artifact, Biome hazards, etc.
 Implemented partial controller support.
 Toggle has been replaced with press and hold to inspect characters during gameplay.
 Material pass for Theosus statue and other environmental props.
 Added Ember Bomb explosion particle effect.
 Added a highlight effect on hover for all characters.
 In-game character panel with detailed stats, equipped items, and previews of their traits and abilities.
 HP stat now shows both the current and maximum HP values.
 Improved AI responsiveness (reduced delays).
 Visual polish updates on the World Map.
 Province details now show up for all captured provinces.
 Captured provinces are indicated by a green outline on the World Map.
 New sprite animation in the Main Menu.
 Updated animations for all Zaha’Ryn enemies (Terrodon, Siege breaker, and Shaman).
 Updated trait, ability, and stat icons for multiple champions and enemies.
 Updated Frost Wraith’s idle animation.
 Minor HUD improvements.
 Removed injured state animations for all champions.
 Updated the trajectory of casting on a targetable ability.
 Added an animation for when a Jazis shard is consumed.
 Updated the Tutorial Flow.
 Added a turn timer below the turn start banner.
 Added Defeat text prompts for all battle modes.
 Improved Character Selection, Move, and Overwatch UX.
 Tooltips now appear on Threat and Opportunity tiles.
 Added a visual indicator (blue zone) in Retrieve Mode to interact with the Artifact. 
 Hovering over a threat tile (indicated by red exclamation mark) now shows trajectory lines to the corresponding enemies with overlapping overwatches.
 On hovering over a move tile, crossed-sword icons may appear over one or more enemies to indicate attack opportunities.
 Updated Portrait videos for all characters.
 Snow Level visual updates.
 Added a fog of war effect for new provinces on the World Map.
 Updated particle effects for Abilities and Traits.
 Added a desaturation effect to the HP bar for champions and enemies after moving and setting an overwatch.
 Added a “Level Up” text prompt in the victory screen for all Champions when gaining experience.
 Updated Input Icons.
 Added Buffs on Mini HUD.
 Updated the cursor with a crosshair when casting on a targetable ability.


Fixes:

 Martyr’s Rite no longer heals the target.
 Removed the Secondary Objective from Boss Battles.
 Fixed Snow Level and Shade LOD issues.
 The execute modifier no longer triggers on Boss characters.
 Targets now react to Siege Breaker’s attacks.
 The Raider’s attacks are now triggering as intended.
 Player stats now update correctly when equipping items with a negative HP stat value.
 Provinces revealed post-victory are no longer assigned identical battle modes.
 Primary and secondary rewards no longer appear for provinces revealed post-victory.
 Miscellaneous minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Demo Update (v0.10.11d)
notes.content:
Minor bug fixes & optimization.


More Updates are coming soon. :)

notes.title: Major Demo Update (v0.10.06d)
notes.content:
HIGHLIGHTS

 Updated starting champions - Pyromancer, Berserker, and Ranger
 Added a new enemy – Terrodon.
 Added a new battle mode - Retrieve the Artifact and return to the safe zone before turns run out.
 Added a new battle hazard for the Mountain biome. Frost wraith - Whenever a unit takes an overwatch hit while it is adjacent to this creature, it will deal damage and apply Frostbite to it.
 Added the option to Undo any action that has not triggered an overwatch.
 Added Sub-objective for battles. An additional enemy (non-hostile) unit spawns at the start of the  battle. Eliminate the unit to complete the Sub-objective.
 Added a Tips/Hints panel that can be accessed anytime during battle.
 Added a new Dialogue event system.
 Added an intro for the game backstory.

BALANCE

 Concussive blast trait (Zephyr) updated with a passive ability to fling enemies out of the arena, provided they are standing at the edge, instantly killing them.
 Increased Goblin sell sword and bowmen health from 6 to 8.
 Added “Double Move” ability to Relic (now Ember Bomb) for more mobility options.
 Terra and Arcane resources are no longer available at the start of the campaign.
 The destination zone for the Relic (now Ember bomb) has been reduced.
 Reduced Relic (now Ember Bomb) health from 8 to 6.

TWEAKS

 Shard rewards now add a shard rather than restoring a consumed one.
 Escort battle reworked - You must now escort the Ember bomb to the Shrine of Theosus and destroy it.
 Redistributed rewards between Primary and Secondary objectives.
 Bleed status effect can no longer deal fatal damage to the affected unit.
 Blood link status effect now deals 2 damage for 2 turns to the affected unit. 

FIXES

 Fixed an occasional blocker bug while the ranger was attacking.
 Fixed an exploit related to Jazis shards.
 Floor fix in Mountain biome
 Fixed audio sync issues
 SFX slow motion fix
 LOD Fixes for certain characters.

UI
Quality of life

 Added an expanded view of the Character panel (Magnify button) that provides details and previews of traits and abilities as well as the items equipped. 
 All icons have been revamped for a cleaner and simpler look.
 Removed the ability to check the overlap of enemy move and overwatch patterns by hovering over them.
 You can now preview enemy threats and attack opportunities of an ally champion just by selecting them.

Tooltips

 Added tooltips for all champion and enemy traits.

Loadout

 Notification dots to indicate the availability of items, traits, and ability upgrades.
 Added Ability previews for all champions.
 On upgrading stats, traits, and abilities, a particle effect shall appear over the champion.

AUDIO

 Removed VOs for all champions.

ANIMATIONS

 Move and Attack Animations, along with movement speeds, are updated to make the game faster.
 Improved idle animations of certain characters.
